edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (W): 14s cd at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — count it before stepping up, and don't dump burst into the dash since he's untargetable until he lands. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.
edits.after: He's committed once Twisted Advance lands — E, Q and autos in the root window before he peels away.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.

edits.before: Q-bloom the pair — bot's formations eat the triple pop beautifully.
edits.after: You out-poke Maokai early — Q lands before his Saplings matter.

edits.before: Clone games begin: the lane's information war opens in your favor.
edits.after: Your level-2 Q+E root spike beats his slow, sapling-dependent kit.

edits.before: Disguise the margins — every wrong guess they make is tempo you banked.
edits.after: His W engage and sapling wave control let him dictate the lane now.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — the disguise plus R turns brush control into ambush law.
